chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Real Madrid against Milan, in the Champions League. Leão gallops down the left, past two defenders, into the box, and squares it for Reijnders... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The defenders chase Leão, and Reijnders runs late from midfield, into the empty space. One touch, then a low shot, right under the keeper!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: arrive late in the box. Defenders watch the strikers, and forget the midfielder. So wait, then run into the gap, and be the one they forget!
